about: Recipes that not every trainer of the profession teaches: who does. Read 2026-11-18 in a browser from Wowhead's Forever pages - what an NPC teaches (the 'Teaches' list of its page). Each group's spells are the ones its Master trainers teach and a city's trainer does not (the rank Artisan itself, and each side's own Faction Banner, aside). The user, 2026-11-18: 'red mageweave bag is only taught by the master trainers - not the artisan ... also looks like in felwood'. Every profession is read: Tailoring, Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Leatherworking, Engineering, Enchanting (three tiers: a city's Expert Enchanter, the Artisan Enchanters out in the world, the Master) and First Aid have such recipes; Mining and Cooking have none (npc=5513 Gelman Stonehand teaches all twelve smelts and all four ranks of Mining; npc=5482 Stephen Ryback teaches every trainer's cooking recipe but Spinefin Halibut, which nobody read teaches). Wowhead answers 403 after about five to ten pages in a sitting (twice that day; 30 seconds between pages did not help) - the user: 'we can just look stuff up at slower intervals': one page every five minutes went through, 14 pages in a row. Not read: the trainers below a city's highest (Journeyman and Expert titles), who may teach fewer still, and most of the Horde's city trainers (taken to match the Alliance's).

groups.name: Master Tailors and Meilosh
groups.read: item=10051 Red Mageweave Bag ('Taught by': Daryl Stack, Timothy Worthington, Meilosh); npc=2399 Daryl Stack <Master Tailor>: 85; npc=1346 Georgio Bolero <Artisan Tailor>: 75; npc=11557 Meilosh, Timbermaw Hold: 86, every rank of Tailoring included. Timothy Worthington's own page was not read: he is the other <Master Tailor> and the item page names him.

groups.read: spell=13920 (the rank Artisan) is taught by npc=11073 Annora <Master Enchanter> alone: she teaches 65; npc=11072 Kitta Firewind <Artisan Enchanter>: 55; npc=1317 Lucan Cordell <Expert Enchanter> (Stormwind City): 29. groups.name: the Triage doctors (as in Classic)
groups.read: npc=2327 Shaina Fuller <First Aid Trainer> (Stormwind City) teaches 13: both ranks a trainer gives and the eleven recipes up to Silk Bandage - not these three. Wowhead's Forever pages name NOBODY for them: spell=18630 Heavy Runecloth Bandage has no 'taught by', and npc=12939 Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen has no 'teaches' list, only the Triage quest. In Classic the two Triage doctors teach them once Triage is done; that is what is written here, marked 'as in Classic'.

confirmed.about: Recipes new in Forever with no recipe item, which the tables took for a trainer's as a guess ('Probably any trainer'): these were in the list of a trainer read above (a city's, for all but the Horde's Faction Banner), so the guess is right and the card says 'Any ... trainer'. Still a guess: Alchemy's four Discolored Healing Potions (1244645-1244648) and Cooking's Spinefin Halibut (1247741) - no trainer read teaches them.
